|translation='''Title:''' Program Trap.

'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on an opponent's droid, or 1 Force to deploy on your droid. Cannot deploy on R2-D2 or C-3PO. After that, if either player draws a destiny equal to the number of characters at the droid's location, the droid explodes. All characters with it are lost.

'''Lore:'''
Imperial computer technicians hide a secret command in a droid's basic operating program. When a set condition arises, overload destroys the droid and everything around it.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text splits the 2-Force and 1-Force costs into two sentences and uses 位置 instead of site.
